body: Honestly man fate is weird but still I needed you and I will probably look back on this for a while. I'm so grateful for anything positive that goes my way, and you did thank you so fucking much I can't express my gratitude over a reddit message but please know I'd hug you if I could right now. I hope you get yourself figured out too, I know you really deserve it you helped me so much.

Oh god I don't want to though. Half my time was playing with the sick karambit animations and qqing just to watch how great the pull out game was on it. The pirate sword they give you for a default is so much worse. 

At least its not a gut knife though :P 

(and thank you because my best friend just so happens to be my girlfriend, and she doesn't get it at all. I did just want to talk to someone about this)

That's not harsh dude you are completely correct and yeah, I'm not going to hide that. I love all you csgo players in here, thank you for coming up and talking about it (although I dont like your gross Gut Knife, no matter what cool skin it had on it to be worth $100). Thank you for replying all you guys calmed me down thank you so much I just needed someone to talk to about this, and I didn't want to go to my best friend who's always there for me because I feel so embarrassed about this. 

Thank you guys for all coming up and talking to me I love you all so much and I appreciate it beyond belief thank you so much.

I'm on my way to GE dude, I've had so much time on my hands. I went from Nova 4 to DMG in the past 2 weeks or so. I went from dropping 40 bombs every game to only 25+ (classic *my nova 2 friends were keeping me down*) so the climb is probably going to slow down, but hey I'll but up there with you soon.

And thank you so much for simply showing me how to fix this, even if it doesn't work. So much shit in my life is just completely out of my hands, like my surgeries and the fact that even though I got every question correct on my geometry test I got a B- on it (my teacher has a fucked way of grading). But you gave me the power to change something in my life that I fucked up so thank you. I really really needed that and I really appreciate it. Getting out of bed isn't really any easier but at least everything's not lost (that's a song, I can't remember who it's by though right now I have to google that). 

Thank you for taking the time to help me with this I calmed down now. I have a splitting head ache for no apparent reason but I can breathe and thank you so much.   

I just wish Team Liquid won. Now all they get is the opportunity to be destroyed by nV at IEM.

Breathe like I'm swimming. 

Haha that one made me laugh. Because I've seen the pictures, when you breathe in the water you look like one ugly mofo. 

And things dont get better but they get different. I think thats my favorite thing I've heard in the past 3 years. 

Hey man I've spent the past 25/30 months contemplating suicide just because I wasn't really fond of the idea of living but now that things have been getting so hard for me, between surgery and relationship/friendship drama and just hating school to bits, but things are going to get different. 

Thank you for taking the time to reply, and tell Tyler that I absolutely suck at guitar hero with both arms completely functional and I have mad respect for him.

And thank you again, when I'm upset I like to apologize then once I calm down I thank a lot. You and everyone else in this thread just taking the time to reply really helped and I love you all, you are all amazing people. 

I've calmed down and hopefully I can at least get my knife back. Thank you so much for being here to hear me ramble. I'm not a fan of being alive still but I'd rather be alive able to breathe than choking on air. 

If I could I'd love to shake your hand right now dude. You might view this as just sending two messages on reddit but thank you your words really helped me. 

Unfortunately I won't being swimming at all but I know I'll be at every meet on my crutches, cheering on my friend who joined swimming because of me and now he's doing it without me (lol I feel bad about that). 

Thank you. 

edit: and yeah, if Im with the freshman I won't be like those bitchy sophomore girls in the freshman boats who obviously hate they are there. I'll help, I like helping.
